purpose: Collapse internal guest/runtime references after Switch cross-compilation and retain the exact unresolved external symbol surface that a Switch host adapter or system libraries must satisfy.
acceptance: canonical guest/title and authoritative runtime-floor objects are both produced for Switch
a relocatable link succeeds across the combined object set
internal guest/runtime references are resolved before symbol inventory
the remaining unresolved symbols are retained as machine-readable evidence
non_claims: A relocatable link is not a runnable NRO
System C/libm symbols may remain unresolved until final executable link
Host callbacks may remain unresolved by design
This does not run the guest or prove deterministic parity
This does not close Gate S2
